newsitem.title: UK: Bass rallies amid positive analyst comment.
newsitem.headline: Bass rallies amid positive analyst comment.

text.p: Shares in Bass Plc rallied on Friday as analysts at leading brokerages said yesterday's sharp retreat following the brewing-to-hotels group's cautious trading statement was overdone.

The stock was up 12-1/2p at 833-1/2 on volume of 4.8 million shares by 1134 GMT, after falling 31-1/2p on Thursday, after warning that trading was running slightly below its expectations in the first 16 weeks of the year.
Dealers said UBS repeated a "buy" recommendation on the stock and Goldman Sachs said Bass remained on its European "recommended for purchase" and "priority" lists.
"There has been a slight downturn in expectations but the stock is trading at the bottom of its range," said one analyst who asked not to be named.
"We've trimmed earnings expectations a bit but we're still looking at 10 percent (profit growth) for 1997 and 1998."
Traders said there was good buying in the stock. "They've been oversold," one said. "They're good value at this level."
